subject: CAIQ: staging artifacts, control handoff, and workshop scheduling
messages:
From: Aurora Security <audits@aurorasec.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: it-contact@cloudbank.com
Date: Tue, 29 May 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ intake and initial artifact request for CloudBank POC

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for onboarding Aurora for the CloudBank CAIQ review. To kick off the scope, can you please share: 1) a control-owner roster (high level) for the in-scope services, 2) any recent telemetry/log samples demonstrating runtime isolation and key rotation, and 3) a small set of artifacts (config manifests, RBAC snapshots, and one example incident ticket).

Attached is our CAIQ intake template — if you can populate the owner column and drop artifacts into a staging location, that will let us validate a subset of high-risk controls ahead of the live workshop.

Requested timeline: initial artifacts by EOD 2028-05-30, workshop the week of 2028-06-01 if possible.

Attachments (stubs): CAIQ_intake_template.xlsx, SIG_sample.pdf

Regards,
Maya Rana
Aurora Security — Senior Assessor
audits@aurorasec.com
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 29 May 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake and initial artifact request for CloudBank POC

Thanks Maya — looping in the owners and a short plan.

Naomi: owner for runtime telemetry and logs (controls around runtime isolation and logging).
Priyom: owner for artifact staging and temporary share (we'll use a locked S3 staging path first).
Kimberly: owner for control mapping and assertions.

Plan: we will (a) populate the intake template with the control roster and owners, (b) stage a small artifact bundle (manifest + one log sample + RBAC snapshot) to the S3 link below, and (c) run a 60-minute intake workshop to walk controls prioritized by risk. Can we deliver initial artifacts by EOD 2028-05-30? If yes, propose workshop on 2028-06-02 10:00 PT.

Staging link (temporary): s3://redwood-inference-staging/caiq/cloudbank-temp/
Drive folder (working): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-CAIQ-Staging

Attaching the initial control roster CSV for your review.

Attachments (stubs): control_roster.csv

— Rishi Malhotra
Head of Compliance Operations

On the telemetry/log side I pulled a short, scrubbed sample set and the runtime manifest. Quick notes:
- Retention window: we keep streaming traces and runtime telemetry for 90 days; raw debug traces are retained for 30 days in staging.
- The attached log slice demonstrates session isolation (token-scoped ids) and a key-rotation event with correlation IDs.
- RBAC snapshot is a filtered export (no PII) showing service roles and the single-tenant isolation label for CloudBank.

Attachments (stubs): runtime-telemetry-sample.log, artifact_manifest.csv

If Aurora needs additional fields in the sample (e.g., full KV cache traces), tell me which control IDs you want emphasized and I can pull a slightly larger window.

Thanks — Naomi
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

To: Maya Rana <audits@aurorasec.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

- I created a short README in the folder describing the filenames and which control IDs they map to.
- Temporary credentials for Aurora emailed to audits@aurorasec.com (valid 48 hours).

Thanks — quick mapping clarifications inline:
- CCM-05 (Identity and Access Management): evidence = artifact_manifest.csv (RBAC export) + caiq_partial_mapping.xlsx sheet 'CCM-05' 
- CCM-07 (Configuration & Change Control): evidence = control_roster.csv (owner + change window) + runtime-telemetry-sample.log (shows config reload event)
- CCM-11 (Logging, Monitoring & Alerting): evidence = runtime-telemetry-sample.log + a short excerpt from our alerting policy (I added a redacted excerpt to the Drive folder).

Action items: Naomi to attach the small alerting excerpt (redacted); Priyom to confirm S3 link accessibility for Aurora; Rishi to confirm workshop time.

On workshop: 2028-06-02 10:00 PT works for me — recommend 45 minutes to cover the top 12 prioritized controls and leave 15 for live artifact navigation.
